Evidence emerged during the inquest that there was inconsistent sharing of documentation and case notes between the statutory agencies and private sector. In particular, there was no sharing of medical notes/care plans between the Birmingham and Solihull and Mental Health Trust and Oak House
inconsistent sharing of medical notes and care plans between agencies

inconsistent and minimal training for managing complex needs

lack of joint multidisciplinary care plan and insufficient contact with care coordinator

escalating risk of ligature use and self-harm incidents
